subject.title: feat(chat): UX-012 — token usage progress meter

question: Should this older horizontal token meter be rebased as a distinct UX variant, or should this PR be closed as superseded by the current freshness-aware composer context ring?
rationale: Current main already implements the central composer context-usage visibility with a richer stale-aware ring, while this protected member PR cannot be auto-closed and still needs a design/ownership choice.

options.title: Keep Current Ring
options.body: Close or supersede this PR and keep the existing context usage ring as the single composer context indicator.

options.title: Rebase as Replacement
options.body: Rebase the branch onto the current chat composer and replace or restyle the ring only if the new meter reuses getContextNoticeViewModel and preserves stale-token behavior.

options.title: Pause for Broader Usage UI
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader token usage and context footer requests settle the canonical placement for tokens, cost, cache, and compaction status.

recommendation.title: Keep Current Ring
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this PR and keep the existing context usage ring as the single composer context indicator.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored both this PR and prior Control UI context usage work, making them the best owner for the UX direction call.
